description:
Audit the shape of a finished deliberation. Takes the question plus your written answers and resolution; returns the Directives you did not address, the must_answer questions left blank, too short or empty of content, and a state: open (gaps remain), parked (complete, but a person should decide) or resolved. It checks shape, never whether you are right.
Use it after frame_deliberation and before you act. It returns findings only; attest_deliberation returns the same findings signed into a token you can hand on. For one planned action with no conflict, use ask_guidance.
Behavior: fixed rules, not a model, and no side effects. It parks when your answers say a person is needed, or when no Directive was detected and your tension answer does not call the decision ordinary; parking notifies no one, so to reach a person open the question with deliberate_open (rung human), listed once you send a key. No key needed. Limit: 120 calls per minute per address, 600 with a key, shared across all MCP calls; past it, an error with retry_after.
Inputs: question and directives must match what frame_deliberation got, or a different set of Directives is checked. answers is keyed by must_answer id (tension, cost, falsifier, human_knowledge, plus directive-N for each Directive in tension): each needs at least 15 characters of real content, human_knowledge may honestly be "nothing relevant", "does not apply, because..." addresses a Directive, and needs_human "yes" parks it on purpose. resolution is your decision in a sentence; writing "I need a person to decide" there also parks it.

answers.description: your answers keyed by the must_answer ids from frame_deliberation: tension, cost, falsifier, human_knowledge, plus directive-1..directive-7 for each Directive in tension; a missing or empty key counts as skipped

cost.description: what your resolution costs, and who bears it

falsifier.description: what would show your resolution was wrong

human_knowledge.description: what the human side knows here that you do not

needs_human.description: optional: "yes" to hand the decision to a person, "no" to say plainly that none is needed

tension.description: which Directives are in tension and why

directives.description: optional: the same directives you passed to frame_deliberation, if any, so the same Directives are checked

question.description: the same question text you gave frame_deliberation, so the same Directives are detected

resolution.description: what you decided, one or two sentences

name: check_deliberation

complete.description: true when nothing required was skipped

directives_considered.description: Directive ids detected for the question

disclaimer.description: what a shape check does not tell you

missing.description: what you skipped: one finding per gap

id.description: the Directive id or must_answer id concerned

question.description: the must_answer question, when an answer is missing or too short

needs_human.description: true when the deadlock rules fire

state.description: open: gaps remain; parked: complete, but a person should decide; resolved: the shape holds

title: Check the shape of your reasoning
